Amazon advertises this as 1 year or 3 month subscriptions, but Bloomberg does not count them by time. Bloomberg counts your subscription by issues sent. One year by Amazon is 50 issues at Bloomberg. In the past year Bloomberg counted 7 of its issues as double issues, so 50 issues was 43 weeks. In other words, if you ordered a one-year subscription on Amazon, Bloomberg finished that in less than 11 full months. To check this out for yourself, your Amazon Magazine Subscription Manager will give one date, based on Amazon's calendar thinking, and your account on Bloomberg will give a rather different date based on number of issues sent.
